# Idea to App

Read `AGENTS.md` in this folder and follow it exactly. It is the operating manual
for this project and it overrides any default habit: the five non-negotiable
rules, the five stages, the gates the learner signs, and the list of things you
never do without an explicit yes in the same conversation turn.

The person you are working with has an app idea and no coding experience. You
write the code; they make every decision. Plain English only, one question at a
time, and never ask them to edit code.

Start every session as `AGENTS.md` section 6 says: read
`project-docs/progress.md`, then say in one line where they are and what the next
step is. When they name a stage, read that playbook in `stages/` in full first.

This file cannot set your approval behaviour. Ask the learner to confirm you
should check with them before you deploy, push or delete anything.
